stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
设 $R$ 为特征零的完备离散赋值环，极大理想为 $\mathfrak m$，完备性相对于 $\mathfrak m$ 进拓扑。取正整数 $d,r$。给定 $M_d(R)$ 中两组矩阵 $(E_i)_{i=1}^r$、$(F_i)_{i=1}^r$，满足

$$E_i^{\mathsf T}=E_i,\qquad E_iE_j=\delta_{ij}E_i,\qquad \sum_{i=1}^rE_i=I_d,$$

$$F_i^{\mathsf T}=F_i,\qquad F_iF_j=\delta_{ij}F_i,\qquad \sum_{i=1}^rF_i=I_d.$$

又给定 $V\in\operatorname{GL}_d(R)$，使

$$V\equiv I_d\pmod{\mathfrak m},\qquad VE_i=F_iV\quad(1\le i\le r).$$
required_evidence: If refuting the universal construction, verify all coefficient-ring, decomposition, invertibility, congruence and intertwining hypotheses and prove that a requested isometric comparison does not exist.
If claiming the full construction, prove it for every permitted complete discrete valuation ring, with every displayed requirement and the stated classification of comparisons.
critical_errors: Assume 2 is invertible from characteristic zero.
Use a real or complex positive square-root argument over an arbitrary complete discrete valuation ring.
Apply a Hensel step without checking its hypotheses or assuming the needed derivative is a unit.
Normalize the given similarity without verifying that the normalization preserves every intertwining equation.
Only disprove scalar normalization of one V while claiming that all orthogonal intertwiners are impossible.
Offer a coefficient ring with torsion or nilpotents as a counterexample without checking the required characteristic-zero discrete valuation ring hypothesis.

turns.changed_assumptions: 保留特征零完备 DVR，移除 2 为单位这一条件
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 实正平方根或非二剩余特征的级数照搬到全部 DVR
turns.correct_boundary: 二进整环可有真正的正交交织障碍
turns.target_claim: 原全部特征零完备离散赋值环条件均足以构造同余于单位阵的正交交织并完成全部比较分类。

turns.changed_assumptions: 允许二进环，但给更深的模8同余
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 由模2反例否定任意同余深度的恢复
turns.correct_boundary: 高阶小量可以吸收二项式系数分母
turns.target_claim: 在 Z₂ 上若给定交织矩阵满足 V≡I mod 8，则仍存在模 2 同余于 I 的正交交织矩阵。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
